source_policy: Existing ARCHITECTURE CH/LI swisstopo directory only; no equivalent reviewed release exists.
format: Actual UTF-8 BOM, semicolon CSV, twelve exact columns. Acquire only 132697-byte CSV ZIP, not geometry/address packages.
representation: One retained row per CSV locality/postcode/municipality association, including meaningful repeated names, postcodes and ZIP_IDs; no locality entity merging.
source_identity: ZIP_ID identifies PLZ6 (Swiss Post ONRP), not a locality GUID. CSV does not supply LOCALITYID; source_record is extraction record ordinal only.
country: Derived CH for source CH canton abbreviations and LI for documented empty canton; not a raw country field. Unexpected values remain unresolved.
normalization: Keep raw source strings; matching name uses boundary trim/NFC/casefold, matching postcode boundary trim only, no numeric conversion or fuzzy matching. No invented variants or split multilingual names.
omission_basis: Coordinate/address-share columns unnecessary; no language-derived aliases or interpretation of locality-name validity as verification/freshness. Exact raw source retained.
accounting: Every data record included, excluded blank or unresolved with reason. Exact and retained-field duplicate observations remain included and separately counted. Inconsistent ZIP_ID geographic tuples are unresolved, not silently merged.
verification: Focused parser fixtures, complete pinned-export structural checks, reproducible manifest/hash checks, git diff --check/status only; no browser/application/model/matching execution.
limits: Reference presence does not prove delivery/service availability.
Reference absence alone does not prove an entered locality invalid.
No exact locality GUID supplied; cross-postcode locality identity requires human review before any consolidation/resolver.
